<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; ">No development shall take place,
including any works of demolition, until a Detailed Construction Logistics Plan
has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority
in accordance with the format and guidance provided by Transport for London –
www.tfl.gov.uk. The Detailed Construction Logistics Plan shall provide for:<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;">a) Parking of vehicles of site
operatives/visitors;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;">b) HGV access to site – loading and
unloading of plant and materials;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;">c) Number of HGV’s anticipated;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;">d) Storage of plant and materials used
in constructing the development;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;">e) Programme of work and phasing;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;">f) Site layout plan;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;">g) Highway condition (before, during,
after);<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;">h) Measures to control dust and dirt
during construction;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;">i) A scheme for recycling/disposing of
waste resulting from demolition and construction works; and<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;">j) details showing the frontage/ the
boundary of the site enclosed by site hording to a minimum height of 2 metres.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p><p>

























</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;">The development shall be carried out in
accordance with the approved Detailed Construction Logistics Plan, or any
amendment or variation to it as may be agreed in writing by the local planning
authority.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="">Notwithstanding the details
submitted, prior to the commencement of
development hereby approved, a tree protection plan and arboricultural method
statement in accordance with BS5837:2012 shall be submitted to and approved in
writing by the Local Planning Authority. The tree protection plan and
arboricultural method statement shall include include the following details:<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;">a)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Location
and installation of services / drainage / utilities<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;">b)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Methods
of demolition within the RPA of retained trees<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;">c)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Details
of specially engineered foundation design to be used in construction of the
proposed outbuilding. Traditional strip / trench foundations are not acceptable
within the RPA of retained / protected trees<o:p></o:p></p><p>









</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;">d)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Details
of construction within the RPA that may impact on retained existing trees,
including those on neighbouring land and which are subject to TPOse)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Full
specification for installation of boundary treatment works</p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;">f)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Specification
for construction of any roads, parking areas and driveways including details of
the no-dig specification and extent of areas for the roads, parking areas and
driveways to be constructed using a no-dig specification. <o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;">g)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Specification
for protective fencing to safeguard trees during both demolition and
construction phases and a plan indicating the alignment of the protective
fencing<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;">h)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Details
of site access, temporary parking, on site welfare facilities, loading,
unloading and storage of equipment, materials, fuels and waste, concrete mixing
and fires<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;">i)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Arboricultural
supervision and inspection by the appointed / a suitably qualified tree
specialist<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;">j)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Reporting
of inspection and supervision</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify;text-justify:inter-ideograph;

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;Design &amp; Access
Statement, 23003 FP1 01.00, 23003 FP1 01.01, 23003 FP1 01.02, 23003 FP1 01.03, 23003
FP1 01.04 REV B, 23003 FP1 01.05 REV B, 23003 FP1 01.06 REV B, 23003 FP1 01.07 REV
B, Material Schedule 23003 FP1 01.08, Preliminary Ecological Appraisal and
Roost Assessment dated 21/10/2024, Fire Strategy Statement 23003 FP1 05.01, Level
1 Flood Risk Assessment 92651 Revision C, PUZ-WM60VAA(-BS), Phase II
Arboricultural Impact Assessment (101 833).
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; ">Notwithstanding the
approved details and prior to the commencement of development, full details of
the permeable paving construction and details relating to the long term
maintenance and management of the on-site drainage shall be submitted to and
approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Details thereby approved
shall be retained thereafter.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; ">Prior to the first
installation of the Air Source Heat Pump hereby approved, a Noise Impact
Assessment with the details of the following, shall be submitted to, and
approved by, the local planning authority including:<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 36pt;"><!--[if !supportLists]-->(a)<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->detailed
particulars of the levels of noise to be generated in the building, <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 36pt;"><!--[if !supportLists]-->(b)<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->details
mitigation measures to be made for the insulation of the Air Source Heat Pump
against the transmission of noise and vibration by reason of granting this
permission, and of times during which noise producing activities will be
carried out. <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p><p>









</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;">The development
shall not be occupied or used until the works have been completed in accordance
with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; ">The development
hereby permitted shall not be occupied until there has been&nbsp;submitted to, and
approved by, the local planning authority, a scheme of hard and soft landscape
works which shall include a survey of all existing trees and hedgerows on the
land, indicating those to be retained and those to be lost. Details of those to
be retained, together with measures for their protection in the course of the
development, shall also be submitted and approved, and carried out in
accordance with such approval, prior to any demolition or any other site works,
and retained until the development is completed. Soft landscape works shall
include: planting plans, and schedule of plants, noting species, plant sizes and
proposed numbers/densities.</p>

<p style="text-align: justify; ">The development
hereby permitted shall not be occupied until full details of bicycle storage
has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning
authority. The development shall not be occupied or used until the works have
been completed in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be
retained.</p>

<p style="text-align: justify; ">All planting, seeding
or turfing comprised in the approved details of landscaping shall be carried
out in the first planting and seeding seasons following the occupation of the
building(s), or the completion of the development, whichever is the sooner. Any
existing or new trees or shrubs which, within a period of 5 years from the
completion of the development, die, are removed, or become seriously damaged or
diseased, shall be replaced in the next planting season, with others of a
similar size and species, unless the local authority agrees any variation in
writing.</p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; ">Prior to the first installation
of the green roof above the detached outbuilding hereby approved, full details
of the proposed green roof and details relating to the long term maintenance and
management of the green roof shall be submitted to and approved in writing by
the Local Planning Authority. Details thereby approved shall be retained
thereafter.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; "><span lang="EN-US" style="">Prior to the
commencement of the development hereby approved, a Fire Safety Statement shall
be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, this
statement shall include details of how the development will function in terms
of the following:<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">1) identify
suitably positioned unobstructed outside space: a) for fire appliances to be
positioned on b) appropriate for use as an evacuation assembly point<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">2) is designed
to incorporate appropriate features which reduce the risk to life and the risk
of serious injury in the event of a fire; including appropriate fire alarm
systems and passive and active fire safety measures<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">3) is
constructed in an appropriate way to minimise the risk of fire spread<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">4) provide
suitable and convenient means of escape, and associated evacuation strategy for
all building users<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">5) develop a
robust management strategy for evacuation which is to be periodically updated
and published (details of how often this management strategy is to be reviewed
and published to be included), and which all building users can have confidence
in<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">6) provide
suitable access and equipment for firefighting which is appropriate for the
size and use of the development.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p>















</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">The development
shall be operated in accordance with the approved details in perpetuity.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; ">The development
hereby permitted shall not commence (other than works of demolition) until full
details of the following have been submitted to and approved in writing by the
Local Planning Authority:<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;">(a) Works for the
disposal of surface water and surface water attenuation and storage works,
including construction details of a new raised patio with void underneath, how
floodwater enters the void, access for maintenance/removing silt,<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;">(b) Works for the
disposal of sewage<o:p></o:p></p><p>





</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;">The development
shall be carried out in accordance with these approved details and shall
thereafter be retained.&nbsp;<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; ">The erection of
fencing for the protection of any retained tree shall be undertaken in
accordance with the approved plans and particulars before any equipment,
machinery or materials are brought on to the site for the purposes of the
development, and shall be maintained until all equipment, machinery and surplus
materials have been removed from the site. Nothing shall be stored or placed in
any area fenced in accordance with this condition, and the ground levels within
those areas shall not be altered, nor shall any excavation be made, without the
written consent of the local planning authority.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p style="text-align: justify; ">The recommendations regarding
the protection of species set out in the Preliminary Ecological Appraisal and
Roost Assessment hereby dated 21/10/2024 approved shall be implemented in full and
maintained thereafter.</p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; ">The windows in the
side elevation of the proposed development facing towards Nos. 32 and 34
Glanleam Road shall: <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;">(a) be of
purpose-made obscure glass, <o:p></o:p></p><p>





</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="">(b) be permanently
fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor leve<span style="font-family:
&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-bidi-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;">l, </span>and shall
thereafter be retained in that form.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; ">The development hereby permitted shall
not commence (except for demolition works) until full details and samples of the materials to be
used in the construction of the external surfaces noted below have been
submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority:<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;">(a) the boundary treatment of the site,
including side access gates and the proposed patio</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;">The development shall be completed in
accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p><p><br></p>

<p>Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England)  Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no development which would otherwise fall within Classes A, B, D, E and F in Part 1 of Schedule 2 to that Order shall be carried out without the prior written permission of the local planning authority.</p>
